method: We kept zero-ozone ENERGY STAR air purifiers certified for rooms of 250 sq ft or less and compared those with the highest smoke CADR, weighing smoke CADR and the five-year electricity cost (certified yearly energy use x current EIA U.S. average residential price x 5). Every model tied with the last one on the selection criterion is listed, so the cut never picks among equals.
name: Best air purifiers for small rooms (up to 250 sq ft), ranked by certified data
scoring: each value scored against the best on the page (best = 1), times its weight; total out of 100

selection.label: Smoke CADR
selection.merge: listings with identical certified values on all 23 reported fields

ties.rule: equal scores share a rank; within it products are listed alphabetically (no measured difference)
